  SPECIAL MEETING

  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City Council will be held on Thursday, August 5,
2021, at 5:30 p.m., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government Code Section
54956)

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social
distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 (https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-
content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council at the Special Meeting of
August 5, 2021, at 5:30 P.M. for open session as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  dissemination and consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance
  Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To
  ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit
  comments prior to 1:00 P.M., the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda
  number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments
  received after 1:00 P.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public
  record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.
  2.  In Person: The Library Lecture Hall (located adjacent to the Main Library) will be open to provide members of
   Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To
  ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit
  comments prior to 1:00 P.M., the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda
  number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments
  received after 1:00 P.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public
  record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.
  2.  In Person: The Library Lecture Hall (located adjacent to the Main Library) will be open to provide members of
  the public with an opportunity to address the Legislative Body on Open Session Items.

The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to participate in the legislative process; however, members of
the public who wish to orally address the Legislative Body must use Option Number 2 listed above.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132),
and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related
modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such
reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280,
FAX at 310-412 -5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to
athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

Inglewood, California
  August 5, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Thursday, August 5, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 5:30 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  Council Members Padilla, and Morales.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager
  Jeffery Lewis  Senior Assistant City Attorney
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

301  AGREEMENT NO. 21-216 APPROVED – RIGHT OF ENTRY AND INDEMNITY
  FOR PRE-CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES BETWEEN MURPHY’S BOWL LLC
  AND THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD. Staff report dated August 5, 2021, was presented
  recommending approval of a Right of Entry and Indemnity Agreement for Pre-
  Construction Activities between Murphy’s Bowl LLC, and the City of Inglewood
  regarding development of the Inglewood Basketball and Entertainment Center (“IBEC”).

  It was moved by Council Member Faulk, and seconded by Council Member Dotson that
  the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 21-216, Right of Entry and
  Indemnity. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Morales, and Padilla.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 5:31 p.m.

  Approved this 12th day of October, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ____________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
